items.instrument: Setaram MHTC 96 DSC apparatus (SETARAM Instrumentation, Caluire, France)
items.quote: Thermal analysis by differential scanning calorimetry (DSC) was performed on samples 1e6 using a Setaram MHTC 96 DSC apparatus (SETARAM Instrumentation, Caluire, France).
For all samples, the tests were run at  5 K/min from about 50 K below the expected lowest reaction temperature to about 50 K above the expected highest reaction temperature.
Scanning electron microscope (SEM), CamScan 44 was used to analyze the microstructure of the samples after thermal analysis.
The samples were analyzed by powder X-ray diffraction using a Siemens D5000 diffractometer.

The pure elements were weighed out with total mass of about 500 mg, pressed into pellets, in order to break any oxide layers, and placed in a thinwalled tantalum (Ta) capsule which comprised of a small cylinder and two ends.
